title: cyperus fuscus subsp. virescens
intro: Cyperus fuscus subsp. virescens, commonly known as Green Sedge or Green Cyperus, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and treating fever, as well as its uses in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus fuscus subsp. virescens include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with colds, bronchitis, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
